categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches descriptor derivation and cache indexing in `src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp` and `src/wallet/walletutil.h` under the Wallet label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a wallet correctness and performance bug where importing descriptors with non-zero range starts derives keys from index 0. This caused transactions below the start range to be treated as owned during rescan only to drop out of the wallet balance upon reload, while also eliminating massive derivation delays (benchmarked from 19.5s to 0.09s).
